label: original-07
name: Record process-kill qualification environment
run:
{
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'
  sha256sum Cargo.lock
  rustc -Vv
  uname -a
  lscpu
  free -b
  df -T .
  printenv STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE
} | tee failure-close-process-environment.log

label: original-08
name: Qualify committed failure-close process-kill boundaries
run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::failure_close::process::failure_close_survives_os_kill_at_each_committed_drain_boundary \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee failure-close-process-qualification.log
# Rust's test harness exits successfully even when a filter matches zero
# tests. Require all six machine-readable checkpoints as well as exit 0.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_PROCESS_KILL_EVIDENCE=' failure-close-process-qualification.log)" = 6

label: new-mcp
name: Qualify mandatory MCP host-bound state ingress
run:
set -euo pipefail
{
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'
  sha256sum Cargo.lock
  rustc -Vv
  uname -a
  df -T .
  printf 'configured_postgres_image=%s\n' "$STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE"
  printf 'configured_postgres_major=%s\n' "$STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_MAJOR"
  printf 'STATEKNOT_REQUIRE_POSTGRES_TESTS=%s\n' "$STATEKNOT_REQUIRE_POSTGRES_TESTS"
  for setting in CARGO_INCREMENTAL CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG \
    CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OPT_LEVEL CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OVERFLOW_CHECKS; do
    printf '%s=%s\n' "$setting" "${!setting}"
  done
} > mcp-bound-state-environment.log
cargo test -p stateknot --test mcp_bound_state --locked -- \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee mcp-bound-state-qualification.log
test "$(grep -c '^running 15 tests$' mcp-bound-state-qualification.log)" = 1
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_MCP_BOUND_STATE_POSTGRES:' mcp-bound-state-qualification.log)" = 1
test "$(grep -Fxc 'STATEKNOT_MCP_BOUND_STATE_POSTGRES: consumers=3 positive_commits=6 refused_rebinds=12 tenant_ledgers=2 complete_journals=true' mcp-bound-state-qualification.log)" = 1
test "$(grep -Ec '^test result: ok[.] 15 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in [0-9.]+s$' mcp-bound-state-qualification.log)" = 1
if grep -Fq 'STATEKNOT_MCP_BOUND_STATE_POSTGRES_SKIPPED:' mcp-bound-state-qualification.log; then
  exit 1
fi

label: original-48
name: Record reduced host qualification metadata
run:
set -euo pipefail
source_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
source_tree="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
cargo_lock_sha256="$(sha256sum Cargo.lock | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
dataset_sha256="$(sha256sum docs/scenarios/README.md | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
configuration_sha256="$(printf '%s\n' \
  'profile=ci_reduced' \
  "postgres_image=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE}" \
  'synchronous_commit=on' \
  'topology=1,1,1,1' | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
logical_cpus="$(nproc)"
cpu_model="$(lscpu | awk -F: '/Model name:/ { sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", $2); print $2; exit }')"
test -n "$cpu_model"
memory_bytes="$(awk '/MemTotal:/ { print $2 * 1024 }' /proc/meminfo | cut -d . -f 1)"
kernel="$(uname -sr)"
{
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_SOURCE_COMMIT=${source_commit}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_SOURCE_TREE=${source_tree}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CARGO_LOCK_SHA256=${cargo_lock_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_DATASET_SHA256=${dataset_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CONFIGURATION_SHA256=${configuration_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_LOGICAL_CPUS=${logical_cpus}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CPU_MODEL=${cpu_model}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_MEMORY_BYTES=${memory_bytes}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_KERNEL=${kernel}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_MAJOR=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_MAJOR}"
} | tee -a "$GITHUB_ENV" > reduced-host-qualification-environment.log
printf '%s\n' "postgres_image=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE}" \
  >> reduced-host-qualification-environment.log
